# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.x     | ✅        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Instead, email the maintainer at:

**security@example.com**
<!-- Replace security@example.com before publishing -->

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix

## Response Timeline

- **Within 48 hours** — acknowledgement of your report
- **Within 7 days** — initial assessment and next steps

## Disclosure Policy

We will coordinate a disclosure timeline with you. Please give us reasonable
time to patch before any public disclosure.
